$Comment: The most of any one damage type's hits the carrier can resist through the DamageResist_<Type> stats, in whole percent points (80 resists at most four fifths of a hit, so no resistance reaches immunity). This file's Max is the ceiling every player starts with: a server retunes it by shipping a same-id file, and an item's StatModifiers raise or lower it for its wearer like any stat. It bounds each type on its own, never the sum of two types, and within a type it bounds the whole sum: the DamageResist_<Type> share takes only the room worn armor and every other resistance effect on that type leave, so armor plus the stats never reach immunity (armor alone past it is the game's own and stays). A mod may answer the ceiling with a rule of its own instead (ziggfreed-common's DamageResistances.installCeiling).
